segmentation_lexicon.description: script/prepare_lexicon.py output (.cache/mcbopomofo/lexicon.tsv) followed by Resources/local_phrases.tsv, as script/build_site_assets.sh concatenates them

build: python tools/homophone_bigram.py build <the four shards> --resources <dir with lexicon.tsv> --out pairs.tsv --keep 3
python tools/homophone_bigram.py export --pairs pairs.tsv --out homophone.bin --top-pairs 200000 --rank sqrt --min-count 3 --cap 4 --smooth 3
